introduction: Hawaiʻi’s family cash-assistance programs include TANF and the state-funded TAONF pathway. DHS reviews family eligibility and First-To-Work participation through financial-assistance intake.
description: Hawaiʻi’s family cash-assistance programs include TANF and the state-funded TAONF pathway. DHS reviews family eligibility and First-To-Work participation through financial-ass

sections.who: TANF concerns eligible households with a specified relative adult and a minor dependent child living together. Hawaiʻi describes TAONF as the parallel state-funded route for some families that cannot receive federal TANF because of citizenship circumstances. Financial and other requirements apply.
sections.get: Approved families receive temporary cash support for daily essentials. First-To-Work can provide employment, education and related support for participating families.
sections.docs:
• Prepare income and household information.
  • Have children’s identity and relationship information available.
  • Gather records relevant to caregiving, disability or another participation circumstance for DHS to assess.
sections.apply:
1. Request financial assistance

    Use the application link on DHS’s TANF and TAONF page or ask BESSD about the PAIS and paper routes.

  2. Explain the household circumstances

    Identify the adults and children living together and provide the requested family information.

  3. Complete DHS follow-up

    Respond to verification and participation requests. Discuss any concern about child-support cooperation or work activities with the caseworker.
sections.after: Read the decision and First-To-Work instructions. Keep records of required activities and report changes using the instructions for your case.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Hawaiʻi TANF and TAONF eligibility and services, BESSD application contact information. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is TANF the only family cash program?
No. Hawaiʻi also describes TAONF, a state-funded parallel program for eligible families affected by TANF citizenship rules.
Yes. The state links TANF and TAONF to First-To-Work participation and support.
Does one application determine all benefit programs?
The financial-assistance intake begins the review; DHS applies each program’s eligibility rules.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
